changelog:
• NEW: Movie of the Day - a free film picked for you every day, matched to the season (Heritage Day, Freedom Day, Easter, Christmas and more)
• NEW: Share straight to WhatsApp, X or Facebook - or the native share sheet for everything else
• NEW: Announcements can be targeted by country - so South African viewers hear about South African things first
• NEW: Private usage analytics - Vista learns how the app is used from its own site, with no personal data
• FIXED: Sharing a movie or TV show now points to the real Vista Cinema link
• IMPROVED: The TV build now scrolls properly with a remote - rows snap, the page follows focus, and posters stay in frame
